Upgrading a skip on edge 2 to a 3x3 conv improved accuracy on all datasets in runs 21, 23 and 28, mostly more than other replacements.
Adding a skip to an empty final edge gave a gain in run 79, while replacing real ops with skip mostly hurt (runs 71, 76, 78, 80).
